insights.summary: Finance and procurement push back on paying separately for add-ons (PreSense, QM seats, AI Voice Agent minutes) at renewal.
insights.quote: Every time something new gets added, it's a separate approval with a separate justification, and by the time we get to renewal it feels like we're re-buying the platform three more times.

insights.summary: Marchex is quoting lower per-rooftop pricing to dealer groups, sometimes with call scoring included.
insights.quote: They came in under what we're paying now on a per-rooftop basis, and they were throwing call scoring into the number.

insights.summary: Customer links "add-on pricing friction at renewal" to the renewal decision.
insights.quote: If that doesn't get easier, I can't promise we're not looking at what else is out there before January.
